you_should_know.title: Legal experts weigh in on South County ICE facility lawsuit
you_should_know.summary: Santa Clara County (the county that contains San Jose) and California state leaders are preparing for a legal fight to block a planned U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) facility in South County, the southern portion of the county. A lawsuit filed the previous month by California Attorney General Rob Bonta and county officials argues that the federal government illegally bypassed environmental laws, local zoning rules and other statutes in advancing the project. Legal experts offered their assessment of the case as it moves forward.
